messages:
tina: quick ping — PR #8721 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8721). Small batching tweak, but CI keeps failing on the payment-e2e job (timeout). 3/5 runs fail with the same test. can someone take a look? :eyes:
ci-bot: Payment-e2e · job 54 failed — http://ci.redwood/pipelines/54 · failed tests: payment_flow::checkout_timeout · exit code 1
alex: can you paste the failing test output? tiny logs help a lot. also is this reproducible locally?
tina: repro only in CI so far. log snippet:```
== RUN   TestCheckoutFlow
waited for signal but timed out after 30s
ERROR: context deadline exceeded
stack: goroutine 42 [sleep]:
    server/simulate.go:87 +0x3a
    ...
```
jon: that looks like the test is timing out waiting for an external webhook. last time we saw this it was due to the kv-cache eviction timing when batching spikes. did this PR change any wait/retry intervals?
tina: PR only changes how we group items into batches (batch size toggles), no retry logic touched. but batching could affect timing.
sasha: i can run a bisect tomorrow morning if you want. quick try: can someone trigger a rerun with the flaky-tolerant flag? iirc we have a rerun job that adds extra timeouts.
dev-bot: Rerun triggered by sasha for job 54 -> job 54.rerun.2 (queued)
alex: idea — if you add a short sleep before the webhook in the test harness it might stabilize; not ideal but useful to confirm timing hypothesis. alternatively, jon if you can bisect that would be great.
jon: putting this on my list. i'll bisect against the batch-size commits and try to reproduce on an isolated runner. if i find a suspect commit i'll post a minimal repro and suggested revert.
tina: thanks — if nobody can get to it quickly and CI keeps blocking merges, can we mark the test flaky with an xfail for the short term? not ideal but unblock other PRs.
sasha: +1 to temporary xfail if we have a clear follow-up issue. please open issue and link to this thread.
tina: opened issue #1904 with logs and steps. assigning to jon.
ci-bot: Note: job 54.rerun.2 started on runner r7 (linux-gpu-2).
jon: ack. i'll update here with findings. if i don't have anything by EOD i'll flip the test to xfail so main isn't blocked. :clock4:
